annotations.title: Take back what one file wrote

description: Take back the rows one file wrote onto a declared format — **exactly those rows and no others**. Called with no `reading`, it lists every file read onto the format with when, and how many rows each still has. **Dry-runs by default** and writes nothing until `commit: true`. **The reader is kept** (forgetting one is `readers`), so supersede → correct the file → read it again is one call each. This is how a file read twice stops being two copies; a file is matched by its bytes, never row by row.

commit.description: Do it. Omit or false for the dry run.

path.description: Absolute path to a .emd file on this machine.

reading.description: The reading to take back, by id. Omit to list what this format has read.
